subject: PioneerCloud security ops onboarding — sync + artifact checklist
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@pioneercloud.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: securityops@pioneercloud.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: PioneerCloud initial security ops onboarding and artifact needs

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the quick intro. PioneerCloud is moving forward with a scoped production integration next quarter and our security ops team would like to run a short onboarding call to align on evidence transfer, retention windows, and log schema expectations before we kick off the SIG/CAIQ deep-dive.

Top of mind for our team:
- Encryption key custody model (do you use KMS or HSM; who holds keys for Private deployments?)
- Sample log retention and access process for a 90-day window
- Proof points: SOC 2 report (redacted ok), CAIQ baseline, network topology diagram
- How audit logs and console access are exported for customers (format, frequency)

Can we schedule a 30–45 minute call next week? Availability here: Tue 6/15 10–12 PDT, Wed 6/16 13–16 PDT.

I attached our CAIQ baseline (for reference) and we'll have our securityops alias on the thread.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Senior Security Program Manager
PioneerCloud

Attachments: pioneercloud_caiq_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 tab)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@pioneercloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 16:21:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: PioneerCloud initial security ops onboarding and artifact needs

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the details and the CAIQ — that helps. We can absolutely run a focused onboarding call to cover custody, retention, and export formats. Proposed slots (PDT converted):
- Tue 6/15 10:30–11:15 PDT / 17:30–18:15 UTC
- Wed 6/16 14:00–14:45 PDT / 21:00–21:45 UTC

Please confirm which works best and whether your encryption engineer will join; we'll include our infra lead and compliance owner (cc'd).

I've attached a short artifact checklist that maps common Pioneer asks to the owner and estimated delivery (redwood_artifact_checklist_v1.pdf). During the call we can mark any items you want prioritized.

Quick answers inline to your bullets: 
- Keys: Hosted customers use Redwood KMS-backed keys by default; Dedicated/Private can integrate with customer-managed KMS/HSM. We document the model and provide key rotation notes.
- Logs: We export audit and request logs as newline-delimited JSON; sampling and retention are configurable per tenant.
- SOC 2: We can share a redacted report under NDA and provide the control mapping to CAIQ rows.

Looking forward to syncing — feel free to propose a time and we'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Cloud Security, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_artifact_checklist_v1.pdf (2 pages)

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@pioneercloud.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: securityops@pioneercloud.com
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 01:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PioneerCloud initial security ops onboarding and artifact needs

Thanks, Olga — Wed 6/16 14:00 PDT works for our team; we'll have me + our encryption engineer (Samir Patel) and one of our platform architects.

A couple of pre-call clarifications so we can prep:
- For the KMS/HSM integration in Private deployments: can you confirm whether we can supply a customer KMS key material OR only importable keys? We want to document if key custody stays fully with Pioneer or is split.
- For logs: we routinely ingest ndjson into our SIEM. Does Redwood provide timestamps in ISO-8601 and include request_id and tenant_id fields in every event?
- Can you add any notes on how rollbacks are audited (config changes, model version pins)?

We'll plan to share our minimal compliance packet during the call — otherwise no other docs pre-shared.

Appreciate the checklist attachment — will review and flag must-haves.

Best,
Elena

Thanks Elena — invite sent for Wed 2027-06-16 14:00 PDT (45 min). Calendar includes a short run-of-show and owners. Agenda highlights:

1) Introductions & scope (5m) — confirm attendees and primary contacts
2) Key custody model overview (10m) — Olga to present hosted/dedicated/private options
3) Log export & retention (10m) — sample schema, field mapping, ndjson export cadence
4) Evidence & deliverables (10m) — SOC 2 delivery options, CAIQ mapping, network diagram
5) Q&A / next steps (10m)

Pre-read / links:
- Artifact checklist (attached)
- Shared drive with our CAIQ->control mapping: https://drive.google.com/open?id=0BzPioneer_example
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/HS-20482

Attachments included in invite: runbook_meeting_agenda.md (short bullets), redwood_artifact_checklist_v1.pdf

If there are any additional stakeholders (legal, procurement) who should be included in follow-ups, flag them now and we'll expand the action list.

Regards,
Jonas Weber

Redwood Inference
